flows.title: Create a document
steps: Open the Google Docs home screen.

flows.title: Find and replace text
steps: Open the document. To only search it, press cmd/ctrl + F.
Click Edit, then Find and replace.
Next to Find, type the word to find. To replace it, type the new word next to Replace with.
Click Next to go to the next time the word is used, or Prev to go back.
Click Replace to replace the highlighted word, or Replace all to replace it everywhere.

flows.title: Add a comment
steps: Highlight the text to comment on.
In the toolbar, click Add comment.
Type the comment, then click Comment.
